title: Stuck PDI queue on L2 gateway
symptoms: PDI status IN_QUEUE, line cannot charge
diagnosis: Check consumer heartbeat on L2 gateway
Confirm MES publisher healthy (last publish time)
remediation: Replay queued PDI messages oldest-first (approval if > 5 messages)

title: SAP IDoc ORDERS05 in status 51 (application error)
symptoms: Amendment not reflected in MES order
diagnosis: Check if mapping or source data error
remediation: If source data error: request SAP re-send with corrected values (approval: SAP SD key user)
If mapping error: raise change to Integration CoE
Never patch dates manually in MES

title: PDO rejected — contract version mismatch
diagnosis: Compare payload version vs active contract

title: Production confirmation posting failure (SAP COR)
symptoms: BAPI returns order locked / period closed
remediation: Auto-retry after 5 min up to 3 times (autonomous)

title: Data load NULL / constraint error on batch attributes
symptoms: Batch attribute interface fails with NOT NULL

title: User access / role assignment request
remediation: Assign role per policy (autonomous within policy)

title: Mass balance mismatch reconciliation
remediation: Reconcile with shift in-charge; data correction under approval
